== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|A [[Goldsign]] is a unique manifestation granted to individuals who have achieved the [[Gold]] rank by holding a [[Remnant]] within their core. These marks serve as a visual indicator of an individual's specific [[Path]]. [[Yerin]] possesses multiple Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns that appear as silvery [[steel]] blades or arms emerging from her body, often positioned near her shoulder or back. These [[constructs]] function as powerful offensive tools that can be used to deflect attacks, strike enemies, or channel [[sword madra]] and [[aura]]. While [[Yerin]] has occasionally struggled with precise control over these manifestations, she has become increasingly proficient at utilizing them in combat, even integrating them into advanced techniques like the [[Endless Sword]]. Her Goldsign{{!}}Goldsigns can manifest in various quantities, ranging from a single blade to six distinct arms, and their appearance can shift from shimmering light to looking like solid physical [[steel]].}}
